consequence.statement: Argo CD log output format defaults to JSON instead of text; existing log parsing, monitoring, and alerting rules expecting text format logs may need to be updated.
consequence.remediation: Review and update log parsing and monitoring tools to handle JSON-formatted logs, or explicitly set the logging format to text by configuring the --log-format flag or ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT environment variable if text format is required.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 switches the default logging output format from text to JSON.

consequence.statement: Argo CD's default log output becomes JSON. Components keep running, but log parsing, monitoring or alerting that expects the old default format may stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Check that log collection, parsing and alerting handle JSON logs. If you need a different format, configure the log format explicitly using the setting documented upstream.

corrected.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 switches its default logging to JSON. Environments that rely on the default log format get JSON logs and keep running; the change needs review, not mandatory action.

decision.reason: [ev-bacdc0376810] says only that Argo CD switches its default logging to JSON. A default that changes but keeps working is behavior-change, so the class is review. The proposed text says the old default was 'text' and names a --log-format flag and an ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT env var, none of which appear in the evidence, so the correction removes them.
